sources.lesson: #523/#533: prompt lookup inside the MTP round is taken only when the matched site agrees with the live context for >= 8 tokens (MIN_SUFFIX), drafts up to 7 (keeps verify inside the fused S<=8 paths) or 14 when the agreement runs back >= 32, and starts wide (lookup EMA prior = 7).

mapping.523/533 prompt lookup in MTP: already implemented as self_mtp_copy_draft (runtime/copy_draft.py, rm01 2026-09-19); ported the match-strength admission as opt-in policy keys
mapping.539 PLE gather on the GPU: not ported; see docs/PROVENANCE.md entry for the bound and the residency cost
mapping.517 GDN prework+recurrence one dispatch: already equivalent: qwen4_fused_gdn decode and verify kernels fuse conv, q/k norm, gating, recurrence and norm-gate in one dispatch
mapping.534 dual-die fused verify gate: not applicable: host GPU is applegpu_g17s (single die) and mlx2 has no die-gated verify kernels
mapping.519 MoE verify rows arm on Ultra: not applicable on M5 Max (the PR's own M5 Max cells are inside noise); the same idea was probed as omlx#3797 moe_verify_gather (probes-20260924: ~2% at 3 rows, slower >= 12 rows, not bit-exact)

mlx2_changes.change: CopyDraftPolicy gains min_match, strong_match, strong_max_span and initial_span (defaults preserve the historical lookup and stay out of as_dict/receipts). Lookup measures how far the source agrees with the live context (cap 64) and, when min_match is set, takes the most recent of up to 8 sources per suffix length that clears it; a strong match raises the span cap; the sizer's ceiling becomes max(max_span, strong_max_span). Unlike mlx-serve the gate stays mlx2's windowed ratio-of-sums, not a measured round-cost table.

validation: tests/test_copy_draft_self_mtp.py (11 new CPU tests), tests/test_perf_defaults.py (Flash-Next default). GPU in-process A/B, qualification/runs/fn-mlxserve-ab-20260925/: mlx-serve-policy copy drafts 1.56x/1.57x (greedy) and 1.52x (T=0.7) on copy-heavy B1, prose B1 1.00x, B4 0.98-1.00x; greedy output identical through end-of-turn except teacher-forced near-ties. PLE-stub bound for #539: -2.1/-2.3% ms per round at B1.

verdicts.523/533: default-on for Flash-Next native MTP (policy max_span 7, min_match 8, strong 32->14, initial_span 7); strong span raised to 16 with the fused verify bound 17 (ab-vcap-*.json)
verdicts.539: closed: <=2.3% per-round bound vs 32 GB residency
verdicts.519: not applicable (M5 Max; probed as omlx#3797)
